data.name: AquaDesk
data.detailed_description:
Your Desktop Becomes a Living Aquarium.

AquaDesk is a breeding and raising simulation game that turns your desktop into a small aquarium where tropical fish swim freely.

The fish move naturally across your screen, bringing a calm aquatic atmosphere to your desktop while you work, study, or take a break. AquaDesk is designed to be enjoyable both as a relaxing aquarium to simply watch and as an idle-style simulation where your fish gradually grow over time.

As the player, you will raise your tropical fish by feeding them, changing the water, and taking care of their environment. Through breeding and genetic elements, you can also create fish with a wide variety of unique traits.

The genetic system in AquaDesk is not intended to strictly reproduce real-world fish genetics. Because of this, fish may be born with colors, patterns, and distinctive variations that do not exist in nature. Enjoy discovering what kinds of fish can appear as you build your own unique aquarium.

As you progress through the game, you can unlock new features through a skill tree. These may include functions that make raising fish more convenient, elements that make your aquarium more beautiful, and new ways to interact with your fish. Your aquarium will gradually become richer as you continue to play.

Fun to watch. Fun to raise. Always changing, even while you leave it running.

AquaDesk brings a quiet, beautiful, and living aquarium to your desktop.

Key Features

- A living aquarium experience where tropical fish swim across your desktop

- Wallpaper Mode that can also be used as a Live Wallpaper

- A raising simulation with feeding, water changes, and breeding

- A genetic system that can produce fish with various colors and patterns

- A collection of freely imagined variations not limited by real-world fish genetics

- Unlockable features through a skill tree

- Designed to be enjoyable both as a relaxing background and as an idle game

- Create your own calm and personal desktop aquarium

data.short_description: AquaDesk is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent (64-bit, 2 cores)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with WebGL 2.0 support (Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime (preinstalled on most systems; installed automatically on first launch if missing).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe Graphics or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11.0 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later (Apple silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple silicon integrated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 (Ventura) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later (Apple silicon)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple silicon integrated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
